reason: The cited lines show no host command or code execution. They do show an authenticated POST to the Azure DevOps commit search API using a bearer access token and returning the API response text, so the tool can return SaaS data reached with credentials. The request goes to a fixed Azure DevOps API endpoint rather than an agent-chosen attacker-readable destination, so these lines do not establish a SINK. Commit search results can include repository/commit data such as commit metadata/messages that may be user- or attacker-controlled, and the raw response is returned, so UNTRUSTED is supported.
